title: Automatic completed-coefficient linearity into free local representables
statement: Let l be prime and X any scheme, with its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let R be the inverse limit of the constant ring sheaves Z/l^(n+1), with their quotient transitions [def-pur-twist-coefficient-rings]. Let S be the section-ring reconstruction [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence] of the pullback to X [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] of the condensed ring T↦C(T,Z_l), with pointwise operations. For a test object U whose structure map is proAffineEtale [sk-def-pe-morphisms], define P_U as the module sheafification [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] of the free R-presheaf on the universe-lifted representable h_U. For any ring-sheaf isomorphism c:S≅R, any S-module sheaf N [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and any additive sheaf map g:N_ab→(P_U)_ab, the map g is semilinear over c: for every test object V, r∈S(V), and x∈N(V), one has g_V(r·x)=c_V(r)·g_V(x). This statement concerns concrete free targets and contains no realization functor or normalization.

proof.text: The coefficient-only local approximation theorem gives a covering sieve on which r=a+l^(n+1)b, for an integer a.

On that sieve, use naturality of g and c, semilinearity of the restriction maps of N and the free target, preservation of integers by c, and additivity of g. The action defect restricts to l^(n+1) times g(b x)-c(b)g(x), since the integer terms cancel. This constructs an explicit witness in the image sieve for each n.

Apply corrected adic separation of the sheafified free pro-affine etale representable to this action defect, using the hypothesis on U. All its positive-power image sieves are covering, so the defect is zero. The free-cell construction and its generator-to-section map remain available on arbitrary U.

lean.statement:
theorem completedFreeCell_automaticLinearity (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ) (hU : proAffineEtale U.unop.hom)
    (c : (sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
          (InternalAbelianSheafModule.sectionRingSheaf.{u + 1, u + 1, u}
            (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
            (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} ℤ_[l]) X)) ≅
        Scheme.purTwistRing X (Scheme.purTwistZlCompletion X l))
    (N : SheafOfModules.{u + 1} ((sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
        (InternalAbelianSheafModule.sectionRingSheaf.{u + 1, u + 1, u}
          (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
          (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} ℤ_[l]) X))))
    (g : (SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj N ⟶
      (SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj (completedFreeCell l X U))
    (V : X.ProEtᵒᵖ) (r : ((sheafCompose (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u + 1} RingCat.{u + 1})).obj
        (InternalAbelianSheafModule.sectionRingSheaf.{u + 1, u + 1, u}
          (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
          (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} ℤ_[l]) X))).obj.obj V)
    (x : N.val.obj V) :
    g.hom.app V (r • x) =
      @SMul.smul _ ((completedFreeCell l X U).val.obj V) inferInstance
        (c.hom.hom.app V r) (g.hom.app V x)
